topic: Landforms, Water Forms, and Their Importance
key_concepts: Plateau is flat land on top of a mountain
Island is land surrounded by water
Valley is flat land between mountains
Lake is a body of water surrounded by land
Sea is salty and smaller than an ocean
Stream is smaller and shallower than a river
River is long and flows to the sea
Waterfall is water flowing down from a high mountain part
Landforms and water forms provide food, medicine, decoration, transportation, and building
